**Finding: Compliant** — no redline proposed.

The agreement contains no most-favoured-nation obligation in either direction. Section 3 handles compensation purely as time-and-materials at SOW rates (with Contractor's unilateral right to change rates on 30 days' notice — a separate issue outside this rule's scope), and no clause requires Clear Capital to extend RadialSpark terms no less favourable than those given to third parties or to match competing offers. Since this rule flags only MFN obligations burdening us, the absence of such language meets the preferred position.
